mechanism: Primidone induces CYP450 enzymes and increases renal clearance of torsemide while torsemide may alter primidone levels through electrolyte disturbances; combined use increases hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia risk affecting cardiac function.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, renal function, and primidone levels; ensure adequate potassium and magnesium supplementation; assess for seizure control changes.
